1. THE HOST CRITERION (frozen in the script BEFORE any host
   sample of this confrontation was read): bin index
   b = host_ns // 1000 ns (1 us, fixed physical scale, NOT
   derived from any sample); per-window share vectors over the
   union support of occupied bin indices (percent); W_in = max
   L1 over same-letter window pairs, W_out = min L1 over
   opposite-letter window pairs; SHAPES SEPARATE iff W_out >
   W_in -- the s234 rule shape on the channel's own frozen
   quantization.  Letters are the gpu_ticks letters (re-derived
   and BOUND to the committed s234 rows in section 3).
   ROBUSTNESS FAMILY (frozen here too; REPORT only, every
   width reported whatever it shows): BIN in (1000, 100, 250, 500, 2000, 5000, 10000) ns.
   RAW-SUPPORT SUPPLEMENTARY (REPORT only): the same W_in/W_out
   arithmetic on raw host_ns support.
   PATTERN-LEVEL ONLY (s218 2(e)): NO p-value, NO test
   statistic, NO probability claim.
   PRIOR EXPOSURE, NAMED: the committed s238 report already
   carries descriptive host rows at the reading cell (medians +
   raw-support D_groups_host), re-derived and BOUND in section
   4; no criterion was chosen against any host per-sample shape
   number.
UNIVERSE: the s234/s238 nine-window universe unchanged (27
committed c2 run logs), at the READING CELL ONLY (sum,128,S=16).
OUTSIDE (named, not hidden): the s237 kernel-variant arms
(iter1/iter3/iter8/itervc8 spvs) and the s235 supplementary
arms (anv-tsstage bb-b2/tt-b2).

   decide): the host_ns channel is CLOCK_MONOTONIC submit->
   completion -- an instrument channel independent of the GPU
   timestamp channel, but SPANNING GPU execution.  The pure
   GPU-timestamp-record quantization account does not by itself
   predict a host-channel letter-group shape split; an
   execution-time state imprints both channels.  The observed
   primary verdict is NOT SEPARATE at the reading cell

   channel at the reading cell under the frozen criterion
   (consistency row: the difference is confined to the GPU

   stays consistent, and an execution-time state too small
   for the host channel is equally live).

   the CAUSE stays UNMEASURED -- this row adds a second-
